task: How fast do refunds have to go out?
answer:
Sinew has no document about the time limit for issuing refunds.

*   The "Refund policy" document outlines approval authority based on the amount, but does not specify a timeframe for processing.
*   Care agents may approve refunds up to $80.
*   The care lead approves refunds up to $400.
*   Refunds exceeding $400 require approval from the head of operations.

data.title: Refund policy
data.heading: Who can approve a refund
data.text: Care agents may refund up to $80. The care lead approves up to $400; above that, the head of operations.
